welcome.message: Map where California plant species may face heat stress under future climate. Pick a species, a thermal tolerance threshold (Tcrit or T50), a climate period and scenario, and a leaf-to-air temperature offset — the map shows the mean annual number of days that exceed the resulting air-temperature threshold across the species' current range.
examples: Where does valley oak exceed its Tcrit by mid-century under SSP3-7.0, assuming leaves run 4 °C warmer than air?
What share of the giant sequoia range sees at least 5 exceedance days per year at T50?
Compare exceedance days for coast live oak between the historical baseline and end of century.
Which of the study species have the largest increase in exceedance days under SSP5-8.5?
